basic_info.description: Majestically presiding over the block since 1902 from its perch upon a giant rock, this well preserved and very private Edwardian waits to welcome you home. The front entry hall provides a convenient mud room'' area and the open living/dining rooms with high ceilings and huge windows await your quiet evenings at home. A sweeping staircase takes flight from the dining room to the upper level w/2 large bedrooms and their views+walk in closets flanking a huge spa style bath. Enjoy the south sun from the deck off the rear bedroom, or the stunning 180 degree views west and north to the Golden Gate from the front. Back downstairs, there are 2 more bedrooms, a remodeled bath and a lovely bright kitchen with quartz counters, gold accents, a Caf range and access to the rear garden and path to lower level. The rear garden is a space of tranquility that's easy to relax in with luxury man-made turf and lush easy care plantings. The lowest level, provides laundry, huge storage area and cozy home for quiet work calls or peaceful alone time. Down a flight of internal stairs you will find a huge parking space and workshop area as well as more storage. Great location super close to the top of Bernal hiking, Esmerelda slides, Cortland, Mission St eateries and freeways south.
